facts.fact: Circuit Court 2, Adentan, Accra applied the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) in a judgment of 18 September 2024, treating its sections 17 to 30 and 43 as binding on a data processor.

The court found Bolt Holdings OU, a named data processor and controller, in breach of sections 20, 21, 28 and 30 of Act 843 over a driver profile registered with the plaintiff's stolen identity, and awarded GHC1,900,000 compensation under section 43(1) plus GHC20,000 costs.

The judgment says the Data Protection Commission is established under Act 843 and orders it to see a forensic audit of Bolt's database and liveness checks by other ride-hailing platforms; it gives no appointment of members and no sign that the Commission has acted.
